top_signals.title: In first U.N. speech, Takaichi calls for removal of Japan’s wartime ‘enemy state’ label
top_signals.summary: Beijing has latched on to the clause in its row with Tokyo, insisting it remains legally binding and serves as safeguard of the postwar order.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
